title: PromiseEval - Corporate ESG Promise Verification
description: Verification of corporate ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) promises, requiring annotators to identify whether a statement contains a promise, whether supporting evidence exists, the clarity of the promise-evidence pair, and when the promise can be verified. Based on SemEval-2025 Task 6 (PromiseEval).
